_about: Prestige upgrades, in the order the screen shows them. The player buys each one once, with prisms, and keeps it in all later runs. Each upgrade: id, name, price (prisms, a positive integer), and at least one of bonuses and unlocks. bonuses (optional object): production_speed (a number of more than 1: factories make widgets that many times as fast; the bonuses of two upgrades multiply), starting_money (a number of more than 0: money added at once and at the start of each later run; the bonuses of two upgrades add up). unlocks (optional object, the same form as in research.json): colors lists the colors, and with them their recipes, that it unlocks; each must have unlock "prestige_upgrade" in colors.json. PLACEHOLDER upgrades and values until playtests set them.
